selection_criterion: mean cross-validated F1-score of the positive class (ties within 0.005 -> higher CV recall)
positive_meaning: num 1-4 collapsed to 1 = angiographic narrowing present; 0 = absent (dataset-defined, NOT a clinical diagnosis)
cleaning_log: Target collapsed to binary: original labels 1-4 (139 rows) -> 1; 0 stays 0.
No outlier removal and no resampling applied; missing values are imputed inside the cross-validated pipeline (train-only fit).
